results.title: Christmas Door Decorating Contest Kit: Printable Ballots, Score Sheets and Certificates
results.description:
Bring your Christmas door decorating contest together with matching printable door numbers, voting ballots, judge score sheets and winner certificates.

Download, print and add your details by hand. Choose People’s Choice voting, Judges’ Choice scoring, or both, and print only the pages your event needs.

QUICK DETAILS

• Designed for up to 20 participating doors, numbered 01–20.
• Both A4 and US Letter sizes included.
• 24 kit pages per paper size, plus one shared 3-page Read First.
• English-language, non-editable PDFs.
• Print and complete by hand. No design software required.
• Digital download only. Nothing will be shipped.

WHAT’S INCLUDED

Each paper size includes 9 individual PDF documents, totaling 24 pages:

• Event Checklist & Simple Guide — 1 page
A one-page host checklist covering planning, door numbering, voting, judging and announcing winners.

• Door Number Cards 01–20 — 10 pages
Two large cards per sheet, with a participant/team name line. Each card measures 18 × 12 cm at 100% print scale.

• Voting Ballots — 1 page
Six cut-apart ballots per sheet for People’s Choice voting.

• Judge Score Sheets — 2 pages
Recording spaces for doors 01–20, with three scoring criteria and a total for each door.

• Vote Tally Sheets & Final Vote Summary — 3 pages
Count votes, combine totals and check the number of returned ballots.

• Judges’ Group Results & Final Results — 3 pages
Record each judge’s scores, combine group totals and identify the winning door.

• Winner Certificates — 2 landscape pages
People’s Choice and Judges’ Choice certificates, each with a simple “Presented To” recipient line, date and presenter spaces.

• Vote Here Sign — 1 page
A voting-station sign with spaces to write voter eligibility, location and closing time.

• Contest Announcement — 1 page
Write participation details, deadlines, voting information, judging date, winner announcement and contact details. Voting and joining/contact sections include two writing lines.

You also receive one shared 3-page Read First with download instructions, print settings, a file/page map and a printing quantity example.

TWO WAYS TO CHOOSE YOUR WINNERS

PEOPLE’S CHOICE
Give one ballot to each eligible voter. Each voter writes one participating door number. Use the tally sheets and final summary to count and check the results.

JUDGES’ CHOICE
Have the same judge panel score every participating door using three fixed criteria:

• Creativity: 1–5 points
• Christmas Theme: 1–5 points
• Overall Presentation: 1–5 points

Maximum: 15 points per judge, per door.

Each group results sheet accommodates up to 5 judges. Print additional group sheets for a larger panel.

The 20-door limit applies to competing entries, not the number of voters. Print additional ballots and tally sheets as needed.

Voting and judging results remain separate. Equal highest results share the relevant award. Print one certificate for every winner, including tied winners. If there are no valid votes, no People’s Choice award is given.

YOUR FIVE DOWNLOAD FILES

1. START_HERE.pdf
Shared 3-page Read First.

2. A4_INDIVIDUAL_PDFS.zip
9 individual A4 PDFs.

3. US_LETTER_INDIVIDUAL_PDFS.zip
9 individual US Letter PDFs.

4. A4_ALL_FORMS.pdf
All 24 A4 kit pages in one PDF.

5. US_LETTER_ALL_FORMS.pdf
All 24 US Letter kit pages in one PDF.

Both paper sizes contain the same content. The individual PDFs and ALL_FORMS files are alternative ways to print the same pages.

There are 27 unique content pages: 24 kit pages plus the shared 3-page Read First.

PAPER SIZES & PRINTING

• A4: 210 × 297 mm
• US Letter: 8.5 × 11 inches
• Door cards: 18 × 12 cm, approximately 7.1 × 4.7 inches, at 100% scale

Choose the file that matches your paper. Print single-sided at Actual Size / 100%, with one PDF page per sheet.

Certificates are landscape; the other documents are portrait. Use automatic orientation or print the certificates separately.

Print one test page first. If an edge clips, try Fit; this may slightly reduce the door-card size. Print the shared Read First using Fit on either paper size.

Cut cards and ballots along the guides. Door cards are designed to attach flat and are not tent cards.

White backgrounds and unfilled tables keep large areas of color to a minimum. Grayscale printing is supported. Printed colors may vary by printer and paper.

PLEASE READ BEFORE BUYING

• These are fixed PDFs, not editable templates or on-screen fillable forms. Write names, dates, votes and scores by hand after printing.
• Wording, colors, scoring criteria and award titles cannot be changed.
• No Canva link, editable source files or customization service is included.
• Door numbers and recording rows cover 01–20 only. Additional entry numbers are not included.
• Counting and score calculations are manual. No automatic formulas, online voting forms or event software is included.
• The included award titles are People’s Choice and Judges’ Choice. First-, second- and third-place certificates are not included.
• Door decorations, decoration templates, printed pages, pens, clipboards, ballot boxes and other props are not included.
• Printing, cutting and writing supplies are provided by the buyer.
• Follow your event’s applicable safety, accessibility and venue requirements.

HOW TO DOWNLOAD

After payment is confirmed, sign in to Etsy.com in a web browser and open Purchases, then Download Files. Digital downloads are not available through the Etsy app.

If you checked out as a guest, use the download link in your Etsy receipt email.

Save the files to your device and extract the ZIP files before opening the PDFs. A PDF reader is all you need.

USE PERMISSION

Print copies for events organized by you or your group. Share event printouts as needed.

Do not resell or redistribute the PDFs or artwork, share the digital files, or post them publicly.

AI DISCLOSURE

AI tools assisted with illustrations, page layout and portions of the written guidance. Styled listing scenes use AI-generated backgrounds with previews taken from the supplied PDF files. Decorations and props are not included.

NEED HELP WITH YOUR FILES?

Contact LayersAndDays through your Etsy order and include the filename, page number and issue you are experiencing.
